name: Sequential Neural Posterior Estimation (APT)
summary: Focus expensive likelihood-free simulation proposals near relevant parameter regions while maintaining posterior correction.
summary_zh: 通过序贯模拟提议分布及自动后验变换，对条件后验密度进行高效学习。
core_idea: Correct learned conditional posterior estimates when simulation proposal distributions are adapted.
innovation: Improves simulation efficiency for certain expensive likelihood-free inference settings.
limitations: Proposal design and density estimation can introduce bias.
Training and evaluation depend on representative simulator coverage.

start_here.why: Peer-reviewed APT method for proposal-corrected sequential neural posterior estimation.
start_here.focus: Automatic posterior transformation and simulation proposal correction.
